scope: Read-only official-source investigation; no asset acquisition, login, license acceptance or quality adoption.

sources.finding: Apple Log uses BT.2020 primaries and Apple Log transfer; standard LUT bytes/version/terms/numeric domain not obtained.
Apple Log 2 uses Apple Gamut primaries; a BT.2020 YCbCr matrix alone does not establish BT.2020 gamut.
Separate Apple 3D LUTs for Log 1 and Log 2 to Rec.709 are described; external LUT artifact/version/terms/domain not obtained.

The unauthenticated curl path redirected to https://idmsa.apple.com/IDMSWebAuth/signin.html with HTTP 200 and title Sign In - Apple. Authenticated catalog not viewed; this does not establish that every acquisition path requires login.
Specifying input Log transfer function is not evidence of an Apple-standard Log-to-Rec.709 display transform.
Log1-to-ACES input transform is not a Rec.709 output transform, Log2 transform, or proof of Apple display LUT equivalence; not adopted.
